newsitem.title: USA: Marine Drilling sees improved results in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Marine Drilling sees improved results in Q1.

text.p: Marine Drilling Cos Inc said it expects continued improvement in its operating results during the first quarter because of increases in day rates and contributions from its newly acquired MARINE 500 semi-submersible rig.

The company did not provide quantify the improvements. It also said a recently signed one-year contract with French oil group Total for MARINE 305 beginning in August would boost the company's operating results.
The companies will drill for oil in Southeast Asia under the contract, which is expected to bring in revenue of about $28 million, Marine Chief Executive William Flores said.
